facts.statement: Main battery voltage dropped to 23.8 V at 14:31:42 UTC, violating the 24.0 V lower limit.
A transient current surge of +17% was detected across the power distribution unit at 14:30:04 UTC.
Comms signal strength degraded to -12 dBm at 14:32:18 UTC.

inferences.statement: The battery undervoltage event Browned out the RF Transceiver power stage, causing signal loss, matching historical anomaly INC-047.
inferences.reasoning: Temporal sequence shows power bus dip immediately preceding RF signal degradation.

recommendations.action: Execute COMMS-04 RF Transceiver Low Power Recovery Procedure.
recommendations.rationale: Restores transceiver power relay once battery voltage is verified above 24.0 V.

recommendations.action: Execute PWR-01 Battery Bus Undervoltage Contingency to shed non-essential payload loads.

facts.statement: Payload radiator temperature reached 78.4 C at 06:00:00 UTC, exceeding the upper limit of 65.0 C.

inferences.statement: Spectrometer radiator louvers failed to open, causing severe thermal accumulation matching INC-022.
inferences.reasoning: Radiator temperature continued spiking without heat pipe dissipation.

recommendations.action: Execute THM-01 Payload Radiator Thermal Excursion Response.
recommendations.rationale: Reorients radiator away from solar vector and activates auxiliary heat pipes.
